articles.title: No Laugh Track, No Problem: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Trailer Promises a Bold Sci-Fi Adventure
articles.summary: The first full trailer for the Big Bang Theory spin-off ditches the sitcom formula for timeline-hopping chaos. Stuart Bloom and his crew face cartoon pigs, icy cliffs, and a Supreme Ruler Barry Kripke. Premieres July 23 on HBO Max.

articles.title: From Ohio UFO Chase to Disclosure Day: Spielberg's Lifelong Alien Fascination
articles.summary: Spielberg's new film Disclosure Day, out now, imagines definitive proof of alien life and a government cover-up. His obsession traces back to a real 1966 UFO pursuit, Cold War anxieties, and his Jewish immigrant roots.

articles.title: Clive Davis, Titan of the Music Industry Who Shaped Pop, Rock, and Hip-Hop, Dies at 94
articles.summary: Clive Davis, the record executive behind Whitney Houston, Bruce Springsteen, and Outkast, has died. Starting as a lawyer, he led Columbia and Arista, trusting his gut to sign legends. His family confirmed the news; he was 94.
